scope: Offline code and workflow audit; no live Gemini or Supabase calls. Existing docs/authoring-incident.json preserved.

confirmedDefects.issue: Authoring UI can remain busy indefinitely when an HTTP response never arrives
confirmedDefects.rootCause: Axios has no configured deadline; api() also ignored supplied timeout options.
confirmedDefects.reproduction: A loopback server withholding its response did not time out until the test watchdog aborted. A browser-held progress response reproduced the blocked controls.
confirmedDefects.fix: Forward explicit timeout options and apply a 30-second timeout only to AuthoringWorkflow requests. Preserve uncertain generation attempt IDs and use the existing explicit refresh/retry recovery.

confirmedDefects.issue: Learning outcome suggestions contain sample questions and answers
confirmedDefects.rootCause: The objectives extractor accepted every list item until the next Markdown heading; Q/A-labelled items and bold sample-question section labels were not recognized.
confirmedDefects.reproduction: Two new unit regressions failed with question and answer text included in the suggested outcome.
confirmedDefects.fix: Exclude question text and explicit Q/A/solution labels, and stop at plain or bold sample-question section markers. Retain explicit objective items and source-citation removal; do not infer outcomes from other report prose.

confirmedDefects.issue: Empty successful scan transcription bypasses the 40-page AI limit
confirmedDefects.rootCause: The cap counted successful nonempty transcriptions, personal-data responses and failures, but omitted empty successful responses.
confirmedDefects.reproduction: A synthetic 45-page PDF with an empty mock response on each page made 45 describe calls instead of at most 40.
confirmedDefects.fix: Count each attempted scanned page independently of its result; retain unread pages and PDF cleanup. The browser extraction harness now honors BROWSER_CHANNEL so installed Edge can be used.

existingSafeguardsVerified: Idle and terminal authoring jobs do not schedule periodic GET requests; active jobs poll at 2500 ms. GET authoring does not invoke inference.
Generation attempts deduplicate retried submissions; explicit new attempts can create new batches. Restart marks active jobs interrupted and requires explicit resume.
Gemini transport attempts and lifetime authoring budgets are bounded. Mock quota, unavailable-provider, malformed-output and transcription failures are covered.
Generation uses saved report revisions, checkpoints candidates and accepted drafts, independently verifies answers and preserves partial results.
Supabase failed writes keep a pending retry; API persist checks pending() and rejects undurable acknowledgments. Local PGlite covers persistence/reload and transient-write retry.
Imports are idempotent; report edits use revision checks; detach/replace preserves historical source material.
Question publication, gameplay, grading/replay, provisional short-answer marking, course ownership and API body validation have offline regression coverage.
remainingRisks: The historical 86.5 KB response size and live stuck-generation incident were not reproduced from retained runtime logs. Active polling still returns report content; no speculative API redesign was made.
Live Gemini 503 causes, live transcription quality and Supabase connection termination remain unverified external-service hypotheses.

The browser deadline does not cancel server-side jobs. Backend persistence has no explicit application-level deadline; permanently stalled network/storage operations were not validated against a real provider.
Persistence is a single-process in-memory mirror with sequential table writes, not a cross-table transaction. Abrupt process loss before a successful checkpoint can lose unsaved state.
Passwordless demo login intentionally allows choosing a teacher account. This is not production authentication; replacing it would change the existing feature contract.
Learning outcome filtering is structural, not semantic validation of arbitrary prose. Instructor review remains necessary. Existing saved outcomes are not rewritten.
recovery: Tested browser timeout, lost acknowledgments, duplicate requests, transient persistence failures, interrupted jobs, partial generation and bounded AI errors recover through existing refresh/retry/resume flows without deleting saved work. Permanent outages and cross-process deployment are not guaranteed.
